a subacute respiratory infection with APEC O78 induces a protective immune response characterized by Th1 cytokines, antigen-specific cell-mediated and humural responses and bactericidal antibodies.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the host response to APEC infection in turkeys is characterized by a transient Th1 response in lungs and a distinct anti-inflammatory response in the liver.

a sub-acute respiratory APEC infection of young turkeys induces a robust immune response that protects against homologous challenge and that this response is associated with a Th1 response, increased antibody levels and complement fixation.
